signature_matches.name: complete processing asynchronous IO request
signature_matches.description: host-interaction/driver : signals that driver has finished all processing for a given IRP (part of major function)
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: complete processing asynchronous IO request
    namespace: host-interaction/driver
    authors:
      - moritz.raabe@mandiant.com
    description: signals that driver has finished all processing for a given IRP (part of major function)
    scopes:
      static: basic block
      dynamic: span of calls
    examples:
      - Practical Malware Analysis Lab 10-03.sys_:0x10666
  features:
    - or:
      - api: IoCompleteRequest
      - api: IofCompleteRequest

signature_matches.name: link function at runtime on Windows
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: link function at runtime on Windows
    namespace: linking/runtime-linking
    authors:
      - moritz.raabe@mandiant.com
      - mehunhoff@google.com
    scopes:
      static: instruction
      dynamic: call
    att&ck:
      - Execution::Shared Modules [T1129]
    examples:
      - 9324D1A8AE37A36AE560C37448C9705A:0x404130
      - Practical Malware Analysis Lab 01-04.exe_:0x401350
  features:
    - and:
      - os: windows
      - or:
        - api: kernel32.GetProcAddress
        - api: ntdll.LdrGetProcedureAddress
        - api: ntdll.LdrGetProcedureAddressEx
        - api: ntdll.LdrGetProcedureAddressForCaller
        - api: MmGetSystemRoutineAddress

signature_matches.name: create device object
signature_matches.rule_src:
rule:
  meta:
    name: create device object
    namespace: host-interaction/driver
    authors:
      - "@mr-tz"
    scopes:
      static: function
      dynamic: span of calls
    examples:
      - Practical Malware Analysis Lab 10-03.sys_:0x00010706
  features:
    - and:
      - api: IoCreateDevice
      - optional:
        - description: sets up a symbolic link between a device object name and a user-visible name for the device
        - api: IoCreateSymbolicLink
